model_limits: Uniform rainfall excess, all rain becomes surface water; no infiltration, evaporation, upstream inflow, point source, sink, prefill, erosion, or calibrated watershed claim.
boundary: Every outward perimeter face open to dry exterior at its own bed elevation; no prescribed outlet.
extension_policy: Only extend the main case after healthy but inconclusive two-hour observations. A four-hour evidence replay must exactly reproduce every two-hour non-timing profile value before its uninterrupted continuation; it is not a restored GPU checkpoint.
